Aaron Tshibola.note: Tshibola is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For DR Congo, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Aaron Tshibola.noteZh: 他给DR Congo提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Aaron Wan-Bissaka.note: Wan-Bissaka gives DR Congo one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Aaron Wan-Bissaka.noteZh: 他是DR Congo无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Arthur Masuaku.note: Masuaku has one tournament assist in the bank for DR Congo. The detail is the touch just before the obvious chance appears.
Arthur Masuaku.noteZh: 他已经帮DR Congo制造过进球。价值在于防线还在移动时，选对出球瞬间。

Axel Tuanzebe.note: Tuanzebe has been part of DR Congo's main defensive shape. He keeps the first duel clean so the team does not spend the next phase chasing.
Axel Tuanzebe.noteZh: 他在DR Congo体系里做的是安静工作。他让对手的进攻不容易变成混乱。

Brian Cipenga.note: Cipenga's World Cup has already included a goal against England. The next one may come from the same small window before the shape resets.
Brian Cipenga.noteZh: 他这届世界杯已经有进球。他的看点是在比赛重新稳定前，先找到属于自己的那个瞬间。

Cedric Bakambu.note: Bakambu has been part of how DR Congo turns territory into chances. Watch the run before the pass, not only the shot after it.
Cedric Bakambu.noteZh: 他是DR Congo的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。

Chancel Mbemba.note: Mbemba has already created a goal for DR Congo in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Chancel Mbemba.noteZh: 他已经参与了DR Congo的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Charles Pickel.note: Pickel gives DR Congo midfield depth for games that get stretched. He helps turn a loose ball into a calmer next pass.
Charles Pickel.noteZh: 他适合那些空间变丑的时间段。对DR Congo来说，这可能就是压力到来前的一次干净触球。

Dylan Batubinsika.note: Batubinsika gives DR Congo cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Dylan Batubinsika.noteZh: 他是DR Congo后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Edo Kayembe.note: Kayembe gives DR Congo a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Edo Kayembe.noteZh: 他是DR Congo的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Fiston Mayele.note: Mayele already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Uzbekistan. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Fiston Mayele.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Gael Kakuta.note: Kakuta is attacking depth for DR Congo. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Gael Kakuta.noteZh: 他是DR Congo前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Gedeon Kalulu.note: Kalulu is back-line insurance for DR Congo. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Gedeon Kalulu.noteZh: 他给DR Congo那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Joris Kayembe.note: Kayembe is defensive cover for DR Congo's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Joris Kayembe.noteZh: 他是DR Congo在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Lionel Mpasi.note: Mpasi has been DR Congo's goalkeeper through this run. His value is keeping the box calm long enough for the next attack to start cleanly.
Lionel Mpasi.noteZh: 他给DR Congo提供从后场开始的冷静第一步。看他如何把扑救或摘球变成重新组织。

Matthieu Epolo.note: Epolo sits behind the starter for DR Congo, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Matthieu Epolo.noteZh: 他给DR Congo保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Meschack Elia.note: Elia has already made a goal happen for DR Congo. His value is picking the moment when the defense is still moving.
Meschack Elia.noteZh: 他已经为DR Congo送出一次进球前的传球。重点是机会真正显眼前的那次触球。

Nathanael Mbuku.note: Mbuku is the forward DR Congo can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Nathanael Mbuku.noteZh: 他给DR Congo替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Ngalayel Mukau.note: Mukau gives DR Congo structure when the ball changes feet. He is often most valuable in the second after a loose touch.
Ngalayel Mukau.noteZh: 他给DR Congo控制节奏。拥挤区域里的触球，能变成下一名队友更舒服的角度。

Noah Sadiki.note: Sadiki is there for the part of the game where spacing gets ugly. For DR Congo, that can mean one clean touch before pressure arrives.
Noah Sadiki.noteZh: 他给DR Congo提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Samuel Moutoussamy.note: Moutoussamy is a tempo player for DR Congo. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Samuel Moutoussamy.noteZh: 他让DR Congo在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Simon Banza.note: Banza is attacking depth for DR Congo. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Simon Banza.noteZh: 他是DR Congo前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Steve Kapuadi.note: Kapuadi is defensive rotation for DR Congo. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Steve Kapuadi.noteZh: 他给DR Congo那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Theo Bongonda.note: Bongonda is attacking depth for DR Congo. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Theo Bongonda.noteZh: 他是DR Congo前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Timothy Fayulu.note: Fayulu is goalkeeper cover for DR Congo. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Timothy Fayulu.noteZh: 他是DR Congo门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Yoane Wissa.note: Wissa gives DR Congo a scorer opponents now have to carry in their heads. His goals against Portugal and Uzbekistan make every loose ball feel heavier.
Yoane Wissa.noteZh: 他已经是DR Congo这届世界杯的真实得分故事之一。他的危险在于防守者还没处理完第一个问题，他已经到位。
